title: 1970 Topps RANDY EDMUNDS MIAMI DOLPHINS #34 Linebacker
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This vintage 1970 Topps sports trading card features Randy Edmunds, a linebacker for the Miami Dolphins. The card is part of the base set and has the card number 34. It is an original, not a licensed reprint, and was manufactured by Topps in the United States.

The card measures 3½" x 2½" and is from the National Football League (NFL). It is a great addition to any football fan's collection and is a must-have for fans of the Miami Dolphins. The card is in great shape and is a wonderful example of vintage stock.
